name: RecordCrateBrowser
job: Browse items like flicking through a record crate: sleeves tip forward one by one so the front one is readable
visitor_action: prev/next buttons, arrow keys, wheel or swipe, click a neighbouring sleeve or the 02 / 06 counter to jump; click the front sleeve to open
motion: sleeves rock forward with eased overshoot and settle (reduced-motion: front sleeve swaps without tilt)
art_direction: Record shop: matte graphite crate with a hairline edge light, card sleeves, mustard and teal accents, small flat price labels
